lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots is visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately horizontal rows and vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a coordinate-like grid structure on the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary horizontal ridge is visible along the dorsal-lateral margin, exhibiting a clear transition from high-luminance pixels on the dorsal side to lower-luminance shadow pixels on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: High density of smaller white spots on the dorsal surface of the pectoral fin; presence of a large school of remoras clustered beneath the pectoral fin.
